text:
maria: Heads-up: vendor quarterly roadmaps came in. Key points: H100/H200 slotting windows for Q2 are constrained due to power racks being rebalanced at large cloud providers. MI300 has staggered availability in eu-west-1 vs us-east-1. Gaudi capacity is steady but driver 2.7 has a known regress in kv-cache which vendors claim is low-risk. Thoughts on multi-region announce wave?
chris: Multi-region makes sense. We should prioritize us-east-1 availability first for our dedicated customers, then EU for marketplace. That gives us time to validate MI300 eu images.
oliver: Product ask: if we do waves, make sure we have per-region model variant gating. We don't want customers in eu-west-1 getting placed on h200 if unavailable.
seema: Partnerships note: coordinate with sales on customer-specific slot holds. We should create a "reserve + opt-in" flow for customers impacted.
vendor-bot: AMD update: rolling microcode in partner preview on Mon. Estimated capacity uplift +7-9% in long seq tests.
liam_mi: AMD confirms partner-preview image will be uploaded to S3 at 14:00 PT Monday.
gita_habana: Habana note: gaudi driver 2.7 contains a low-risk kv-cache change; recommend baseline validation but not blocking.
maria: Can we make a region gating table? Example CSV columns: region,sku,available,expected_fix_date,vendor_note. Ops/product please create.
chris: I'll spin up a gating table and link it in the shared doc. Also adding tier priority: enterprise/dedicated first.
oliver: Also add fallback routing rules: prefer MI300 for seq>8k if H200 derates exceed 10%.
seema: Sales: we'll send targeted notices to customers with reserved slots. Partnerships to own the partner note and legal to approve.
vendor-bot: NVIDIA: microcode patch pending validation, ETA mid-week. No public statement yet.
maria: Good. Let's follow wave plan: Wave A: us-east-1 dedicated + marketplace small beta. Wave B: eu-west-1 marketplace + regional SIs. Wave C: rest of world. We'll reconvene Thu to finalize windows after partner-image validation results.
chris: Action list: Ops create gating CSV; Partnerships draft partner note; Eng-runtime schedule validation jobs; Sales create reserve + opt-in template; Legal approve notice.
seema: Noted. Also flag any customers with compliance needs for Private deployments; they may want a later controlled onramp.
maria: Thanks team. Keeping channel for updates. :rocket:
